title: Ibn Battuta: Iraq and Persia, 1326–27
summary: From Mecca with the Iraqi caravan to Najaf, Basra and Shiraz, then Baghdad, a ride north with the court of the last Ilkhan to Tabriz, and a loop up the Tigris to Mardin, before the pilgrim road back to Mecca.

events.label: Najaf: the shrine of Ali
events.text: His first stop in Iraq was the tomb of Ali, the Prophet's son-in-law, at Najaf.

events.label: Baghdad: the Ilkhan's camp
events.text: He found Abu Sa'id, the last khan of the united Ilkhanate, breaking camp at Baghdad, and rode north with the court towards Tabriz.

events.label: Sinjar: a hermit's coins
events.text: On the way back from Mardin a Kurdish hermit at Sinjar gave him silver coins.
